title: useRevalidator
summary: Get the active router revalidation function.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.body: The hook takes no arguments. The returned function accepts RevalidateOptions: route (one route ID/path pattern or an array), reason (manual by default), and optional mutation context. The legacy reason/context arguments remain supported.

sections.title: Returns
sections.body: An async function resolving after revalidation.

sections.title: Usage
sections.body: Import this API from one of the entry points listed above. Keep server and build helpers in their dedicated subpaths.

sections.title: Behavior and edge cases
sections.body: Without targets, refreshes the active page, loaded fetchers, and registered root/layout data. Targets restrict that set; inactive or unknown routes do not load. shouldRevalidate can skip manual refreshes too. Resolves after selected work finishes. This API returns a function.
